question: Pila ang bayad sa annual fixed tax sa City Treasurer para sa delivery van, truck, o motor nga ginagamit sa negosyo?
answer: Sa annual fixed tax sa delivery van, truck, o motor ginagamit sa negosyo sa City Treasurer, wala nakit-an nga impormasyon bahin sa Citizens' Charter. Ang bayad sa annual fixed tax ay maaaring makukuha sa City Treasurer's Office sa Sangguniang Panlungsod o sa mga CTO District Offices, kabilang ang Local Treasury Operations Officer I/Local Revenue Collection Officer I/Local Revenue Collection Officer I/Local Revenue Collection Officer I na assigned sa CTO (based on [S2] and [S3]). Ang impormasyon sa bayad sa annual fixed tax ay maaaring makukuha sa City Treasurer's CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-2.pdf, section 72 (based on [S1]). Ang bayad sa annual fixed tax ay hindi nakalabas sa mga nabanggit na source.

ground_truth: Annex15, Section72 lists annual fixed delivery-vehicle taxes: motorcycle/motorized tricycle PHP240; delivery jeepney/similar utility vehicle PHP600; truck, van, or any vehicle with six wheels and above PHP1,000; water vessel, barges, ferry boats, tugboats and similar watercraft PHP2,000; airplane/aircraft PHP5,000. The section applies to vehicles used by manufacturers, producers, wholesalers, dealers or retailers in delivery/distribution of the listed products and goods within the City. Preserve the six-wheel row wording when classifying a vehicle.
